stories.summary: Curaçao-based gambling site GemBet has been recruiting people in Singapore to set up shell companies and issue fake invoices to disguise illegal bets, after a PayNow funnelling scheme led to nine arrests in July.
stories.title: GemBet issuing invoices to mask illegal gambling bets in Singapore
stories.why: Shows how offshore gambling syndicates keep adapting to Singapore's enforcement — and the money-mule risk for locals.

stories.summary: Senior Minister Lee Hsien Loong urged Australia to deepen its engagement with Asia, saying it would give Canberra more room to pursue its own interests.
stories.title: Australia should deepen ties with Asia to give itself more room to pursue its interests: SM Lee
stories.why: Singapore's former PM weighing in on the region's shifting alignments, as Canberra rethinks its Asia posture.

stories.summary: M1 and Doctor Anywhere disclosed separate data breaches on Friday: M1 customers' NRIC/FIN numbers, dates of birth and addresses were exposed, while Doctor Anywhere leaked names, ID and passport numbers and bank account details; neither has said how many people are affected.
stories.title: M1 and Doctor Anywhere hit by data breaches; personal information compromised
stories.why: Two major Singapore services breached on the same day — a warning for anyone with accounts at either.

stories.summary: CSA, GovTech and IMDA warned consumers to limit what personal AI agents can access, saying scammers could manipulate agents into moving money or revealing sensitive data; they named Dots, Hermes, Muse, Grok Bot and OpenClaw.
stories.title: Singapore authorities warn of privacy, security risks from personal AI agents
stories.why: Singapore's first joint guidance on AI agents — directly relevant as personal agents go mainstream.

stories.summary: OpenAI has closed the first $11bn of a new funding round valuing it at $1.25tn, Bloomberg reported — well below the $30bn at up to $1.4tn it first sought, after the AI market rout cooled investor appetite.
stories.title: OpenAI reportedly raises an additional $11 billion at a $1.25 trillion valuation
stories.why: The AI funding boom is repricing in real time — the world's most valuable AI lab raised less, at a lower valuation, than planned.

stories.summary: Tesla will wind down Cybertruck production at its Texas gigafactory around mid-2027, Elon Musk said on 6 Nov, to free capacity for the Cybercab robotaxi, after US sales fell 48% last year to 20,237.
stories.title: Tesla Cybertruck production ends as Cybercab rises
stories.why: The end of Musk's most divisive vehicle — and a bet that robotaxis, not pickups, are Tesla's future.

stories.summary: Equinix opened SG6, its sixth Singapore data centre, on 6 Nov — a US$290m, nine-storey facility in Jalan Tukang built for AI workloads under the government's stricter green data-centre rules, with 8MW in its first phase.
stories.title: Singapore's first data centre under stricter green rules is open
stories.why: Singapore's AI infrastructure build-out is accelerating within its new sustainability limits.

stories.summary: Japan's government adopted an emergency cybersecurity package on 6 Nov, including a public-private cyber rescue team to be set up within November and AI-assisted detection of attack indicators, after a series of breaches at major companies and agencies.
stories.title: Japan adopts emergency cyber package with rescue team and AI screening
stories.why: A major Asian economy is standing up a rapid-response cyber capability — a model Singapore watches closely.

stories.summary: A volatile week ended lower: the Nasdaq 100 fell 6.4% on Thursday, its worst since March 2020, after the midterm results; US jobs beat forecasts with 165,000 added in October; the Fed held rates at 3.75–4.00%.
stories.title: Global Markets Weekly Update
stories.why: The week's market story in one place — midterms, the AI rout and a strong jobs print.

stories.summary: US employers added 165,000 jobs in October, topping all forecasts, and unemployment edged down to 4.1%; August and September gains were revised up by a combined 84,000.
stories.title: US adds 165,000 jobs, topping all forecasts in broad advance
stories.why: A strong labour market complicates the Fed's December decision — traders now price a rate hike.

stories.summary: Binance's chief financial officer Kaiser Ng has stepped down and Justin Yek has been named the exchange's new finance chief, in a leadership change at the world's largest crypto exchange.
stories.title: Binance CFO Kaiser Ng steps down, Justin Yek named new finance chief
stories.why: A senior change at the top of crypto's biggest exchange, as the sector navigates a volatile market.

stories.summary: The global embodied AI market has topped US$21bn, Deloitte said, warning Chinese robotics firms face a three-year critical window to expand overseas.
stories.title: Global embodied AI market tops $21 billion, Deloitte says Chinese firms face three-year critical window for overseas expansion
stories.why: Physical AI — robots, not just chatbots — is now a $21bn market with a geopolitical race attached.

stories.summary: President Trump confirmed the US military carried out fresh strikes on Iranian air defences on Qeshm Island on Friday, calling them 'minor strikes', while saying talks with Tehran are making progress and mediators push a deal involving the return of IAEA inspectors.
stories.title: Trump confirms fresh US strikes on Iran defenses as talks turn to nuke inspectors
stories.why: The first US strikes since the midterms — and the clearest test of whether the Iran war restarts or winds down.

stories.summary: Explosions were heard on Saturday on Qeshm Island and at the southern port of Jask, Iranian media reported, with the cause unclear — days after the US strikes on the island and amid reports two tankers struck mines near the Strait of Hormuz.
stories.title: Explosions heard in Iran's Qeshm Island, Iranian media reports
stories.why: The Gulf flashpoint keeps escalating even as talks continue, with shipping through the world's key oil chokepoint disrupted.

stories.summary: US Central Command said it disabled the St Kitts-flagged cargo vessel M/V Huda with precision airstrikes late Saturday after its crew ignored repeated warnings and tried to breach the naval blockade on Iran following a visit to an Iranian port.
stories.title: US Central Command disables St Kitts ship after Iran port visit in Strait of Hormuz
stories.why: The blockade is being enforced kinetically against civilian shipping — a sharp escalation in the Hormuz standoff.

stories.summary: India's Defence Minister Rajnath Singh is spending Diwali with troops at Bagdogra and Sukna, then visiting the Sherathang War Memorial at Nathu La on the India-China border today, after reviewing infrastructure and advanced equipment deployment along the LAC.
stories.title: Rajnath Singh to celebrate Diwali with soldiers at Nathu La frontier
stories.why: A pointed show of presence on the India-China frontier on Diwali — with the LAC still tense.

stories.summary: Prime Minister Anthony Albanese has scrapped the controversial sale of Sydney's historic Victoria Barracks after a backlash, keeping the defence site in public hands.
stories.title: Controversial sale of Sydney's Victoria Barracks scrapped
stories.why: A rare reversal on defence estate sell-offs — heritage and military use won over the sale.

stories.summary: The European Commission preliminarily found TikTok's For You feed breaches the Digital Services Act by steering users into harmful 'rabbit holes', and told it to overhaul the recommendation design or face fines of up to 6% of global turnover; TikTok rejected the findings.
stories.title: EU tells TikTok to change 'harmful' For You feed
stories.why: The first EU case targeting a recommendation algorithm itself — a precedent for how all feeds may be regulated.

stories.summary: A US intelligence memo alleges Alice Huang, an executive at Singapore-based data-centre firm Megaspeed, was recruited by China's Ministry of State Security to gather information on Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang and influence chip exports to China; three House committee chairs have asked Huang for a closed-door briefing.
stories.title: Megaspeed exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia CEO, according to US intelligence memo
stories.why: A Singapore-based company sits at the centre of an alleged Chinese intelligence operation targeting the world's most important chipmaker.

stories.summary: India's Defence Minister told troops at Bagdogra that modern warfare extends beyond borders to cyberattacks, drone swarms and information operations, warning that 'the enemy spreads rumours on social media' and stressing awareness of cyber and information threats among soldiers.
stories.title: Warfare now extends beyond borders to cyberattacks, drone swarms and information operations: Rajnath Singh
stories.why: A defence minister publicly framing information operations as a core battlefield — the doctrine catching up to the reality.

tldr: Singapore: M1 and Doctor Anywhere disclosed data breaches on the same day, while a gambling site's fake-invoice money-mule ring was exposed — and Singapore warned consumers to rein in personal AI agents.
Technology: OpenAI closed $11bn at a $1.25tn valuation — well below the $30bn it first sought — as Tesla winds down the Cybertruck for the Cybercab.
Finance: US jobs beat all forecasts with 165,000 added in October, unemployment at 4.1%, as markets close a volatile post-midterm week lower.
Defence: Trump confirmed fresh US strikes on Iran's Qeshm Island, new blasts were heard there on Saturday, and CENTCOM disabled a cargo ship breaching the Hormuz blockade.
Information warfare: The EU told TikTok to overhaul its 'harmful' For You feed, and a US memo alleges a Singapore-based exec was recruited to spy on Nvidia's CEO.
